briefings.title: Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent Holds a Fraud Task Force Press Conference in St. Cloud, MN
briefings.tldr: Senior Trump administration officials—led by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, FBI Director Kash Patel, CMS Administrator Mehmet Oz, FTC Chairman Andrew Ferguson, and Assistant Attorney General Colin McDonald—held a press conference in St. Cloud, Minnesota, to announce a major whole-of-government crackdown on fraud, highlighting hundreds of billions recovered nationally and a wave of new indictments, convictions, and multi-agency task force initiatives targeting public benefit programs in Minnesota.
